profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with more than 8 years of experience. After majoring in Computer Science he has been working in fields related with transportation agencies, fleet of cars, card issuers and insurance agencies. Over these years he developed his data analysis, data warehouse, BI and ETL skills allowing him to work as a Data Architect, BI and ETL Developer. Nowadays, he has participated more active in software development using technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, NodeJS, React and others.
Passionate about his work and the world of data, that's why he always gives his best. As a professional, he is very work-focused and accomplishes tasks to achieve relevant results, adapted to work as a team, customer-oriented and proactive.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description: App to internal control of transactions carried out by sub-agents with reporting module. (Javascript, Typescript, React, Redux, Node, Express, PostgreSQL, HTML, CSS)
positions.insights: Skills: Express.js · Git · TypeScript · JavaScript · Node.js · React.js

positions.title: BI Developer / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development of Iot application for monitoring water metering devices.(Javascript, Typescript, Node, Express, React, Redux, MongoDB, HTML, CSS)
Creation of migration processes through the development of ETLs with the Pentaho Data Integration tool, Automation of ETLs processes and Error control.
Database Management Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and MySQL.
Survey of KPI to be used in BI projects.
Participation in interviews with clients to identify information requirements.
Determination of business rules in the exchange with the main administrative officers of the organization and the stakeholders.
Preparation of the conceptual business models and the KPI used in decision-making.
Data Markets design and implementation.
Development of dashboards in CDF, CDE and CDA using the Pentaho BA server. 
Use of BI tools as PDI, Pentaho BA, Saiku Analytics, Tableau and Power BI, these last to develop dashboards.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Modeling · PostgreSQL · Git · Pentaho · Data Integration · JavaScript · Node.js · React.js

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
Creation of the data migration procedure through the definition of the stages and tasks.
Analysis of the data stored in the source to determine possible modifications during the migration process.
Development of ETL processes using the Pentaho Data Integration tool for data cleaning during migration.
Automation of ETL processes.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Web app to internal control of small investors, in the Frontend Angular 5 and React, in the Backend NodeJS. 
Development of Business Management and Administration applications with the use of technologies such as React, Redux, MongoDB, Express and Node.

positions.title: Data Architect / Business Intelligence
positions.description:
Participation in interviews with clients to identify information requirements.
Determination of business rules in the exchange with the main administrative officers of the organization and the stakeholders.
Preparation of the conceptual business models and the KPI used in decision-making.
Design and implementation of the Data Extraction, Transformation and Loading processes (ETLs).
Design and implementation of Data Warehouses for different companies.
Preparation of reports and dashboards for the analysis and monitoring of the companies' KPI.
Validation of compliance with customer information requirements, through acceptance tests.
Participation with the client in the accompaniment period during the deployment of the Data Warehouses.

positions.title: Internship Student Role
positions.description:
Thesis Project: Migration of the data access layer of the Structure and Composition subsystem of the Sauxe framework.
Migration of the framework's data access layer.
Definition of the Migration procedure.
Specification of the stages of the process and definition of the relationship between them.
Analysis of the application architecture for the evaluation of the content of the data access layer.
Guarantee that the changes made maintain the integrity of the data.
Implementation of the migration from the defined procedure.
Carrying out tests for the evaluation of migration.
